about: Jeremiah was a young prophet who told people the truth, even when it was hard.

pages.title: Too Young?
pages.text: God called Jeremiah to be His prophet. Jeremiah said, "But I'm too young!" God said, "Don't say you're too young. I knew you before you were born. I will be with you and give you the words to say."
pages.lesson: You're never too young to serve God.

pages.title: The Potter's Clay
pages.scene: A potter shaping clay on his wheel
pages.text: God sent Jeremiah to watch a potter. The pot was not turning out right, so the potter shaped it again into something good. God said, "You are like clay in my hands. I can shape you too."

pages.title: A Hopeful Plan
pages.scene: God's people reading Jeremiah's letter in Babylon
pages.text: God's people were taken far away to Babylon. Jeremiah sent them a letter from God: "I know the plans I have for you. Plans to give you hope and a good future. When you look for me with all your heart, you will find me."
pages.lesson: God has good plans for you.
